learning.goal: Native procedural shader disk, point streams and explicit bloom-impostor scope
points: Polar shader fields driven by one native clock
Analytic additive glow differs from screen-space bloom

effect.functional: Black event horizon, inner-white/outer-orange-red rotating disk, 256 spiral point streams, 2200 background points, smooth native wheel zoom and reset.
effect.visual: Centered tilted luminous disk and dark core over a procedurally generated star field, with analytic additive halo.

forbiddenShortcut: External images or video must not impersonate procedural motion
State counts and rotation must reflect native geometry and shader inputs
Analytic glow must not be claimed as screen-space bloom or FXAA

steps.action: Wheel toward the disk, then click Reset
steps.expected: Camera distance eases closer, then returns to 14 with rotation reset

license.assets: Original MIT procedural geometry, polar GLSL and motion math; no external image/video/model assets.
